issue: GEM records FIDYear=2024, but no final investment decision has ever been taken on Etinde. The 2024 date was an ASPIRATIONAL target from Bowleven's 2023 AGM, CONDITIONAL on Perenco taking over operatorship. Perenco withdrew/terminated the New Age interest+operatorship acquisition in January 2024 (Offshore Magazine, 2024-01-26), and the partners (LUKOIL 37.5%, New Age 37.5%, Bowleven 25%) reverted to reassessing the development plan to 'secure FID'. The FIDYear=2024 field therefore records an aspirational/target year, not an achieved FID. Status=proposed is correct and was re-verified.
suggested_action: Clear FIDYear (no FID taken) or, if GEM intends FIDYear to hold an expected/target year, re-label/verify. Confirm Status remains 'proposed' (no FID, no construction as of 2026-06). Independent sources confirming the Jan-2024 termination / pre-FID status (all verified PASS, none GEM-derived): https://www.offshore-mag.com/regional-reports/africa/article/14304127/perenco-withdraws-from-planned-etinde-acquisition-offshore-cameroon ; https://oilfieldafricareview.com/perenco-newage-end-sale-transaction-on-etinde-permit-offshore-cameroon/ ; https://www.energy-pedia.com/news/cameroon/bowleven-reports-termination-of-transaction-regarding-the-sale-of-new-ages-participating-interests-in-the-etinde-permit-to-new-age-194035 .
